title: We have 3,140 base stations M-PESA
columns:
VOICE
We offer a wide range of voice pricing plans on prepaid and postpaid options, often bundled
with SMS and data services
• ‘Okoa Jahazi’ is an emergency credit-based top-up service
• Voice services include national, regional and international roaming services
• ‘Bonga’ is a customer loyalty programme based on usage of Safaricom services
• Value added services include ‘Skiza’, a caller ring-back tone service
